description: Search Texas oil and gas wellbore identities by district, county, API number, plugged status, orphan-well hold, completion date range or minimum depth. FREE tier: up to 25 real decoded rows per call with no API key, so you can judge the data before paying. Asking for more than 25 rows or using offset requires a key and otherwise returns a payment_required error carrying a checkout URL.

completed_before.description: ISO date, inclusive upper bound on completion_date.
completed_before.title: Completed Before

completed_since.description: ISO date, inclusive lower bound on completion_date.
completed_since.title: Completed Since

county.description: Railroad Commission numeric COUNTY CODE (1-507), NOT a county name -- 'MIDLAND' is not accepted. Integer or numeric string. Call describe_texas_wellbores for the field reference.
county.title: County

district.description: Railroad Commission district number, 1-14. Integer or numeric string.
district.title: District

limit.description: Rows to return. Without a key the ceiling is 25; asking for more returns a payment_required error carrying the price.
limit.title: Limit

min_depth.description: Minimum total depth in feet. Integer or numeric string.
min_depth.title: Min Depth

offset.description: Pagination offset. Any non-zero offset requires a key.
offset.title: Offset

orphan_well_hold.description: True for wellbores under an orphan-well hold.
orphan_well_hold.title: Orphan Well Hold

plugged.description: True for plugged wellbores only, False for unplugged.
plugged.title: Plugged

name: search_texas_wellbores
title: Search Texas RRC wellbores
